extract_html_from_text: create an HTMLExtractor instance to extract raw HTML blocks from markdown text and store them in an htmlStash
parse_custom_endtags: use _HTMLParser to parse malformed end tags like </> and treat them as plain data
handle_starttag_block_level: review the HTMLExtractor handle_starttag method to understand how block-level tags are detected and cached
handle_empty_tags: review the HTMLExtractor handle_empty_tag method to see how self-closing tags like <hr> are processed
monkeypatch_html_parser_regexes: review the module-level monkey patches that override html.parser regexes for entity refs, tag names, and backtick handling
